summary: PO 2023 section 7: compulsory basic phase and main phase modules, one of the two specializations (Maschinenbau or Elektrotechnik/Informatik) with 22 ECTS of advanced modules (at least 6 ECTS practical competencies), and the 15-ECTS thesis module. Specialization exams require 77 ECTS from the basic phase.

categories.name: One specialization of your choice
categories.note: 22 ECTS of advanced modules from one specialization, including at least 6 ECTS of practical competencies; requires an approved study plan
